questions.question: On a basic vehicle control skills test, which maneuver can you expect to perform?
questions.explanation: The test may include backing straight, parking at angles, parallel parking, and alley backing.

questions.question: On a bus with a manual transmission, what should you never do when crossing railroad tracks?
questions.explanation: Do not shift gears while crossing railroad tracks. The bus could stop on the tracks and get stuck.

questions.question: If a tornado is approaching and you evacuate the bus, where should students go?
questions.explanation: Lead students to shelter in a nearby building. If no building is available, go to a nearby ditch or culvert. Avoid areas that flood and stay far enough away so the bus will not fall on them.

questions.question: When a school bus must be evacuated, passengers should:
questions.explanation: The driver must quickly decide which exit is safest for everyone to use.

questions.question: Backing a school bus is:

options.text: Only to be done in the morning.

questions.explanation: Backing a school bus should be avoided whenever possible. Only back up if there is no safe alternative. Always follow all safety rules when backing.

questions.question: If your vehicle has a cargo lift, check that:

options.text: The lift is the proper color.

questions.explanation: Check the lift for leaks, damage, or missing parts. The lift must be fully closed and securely locked.

questions.question: On a basic vehicle control skills test, you may be asked to:

options.text: Pull forward into a parking space.

questions.explanation: The test may include backing straight, parking at angles, parallel parking, and alley backing.

questions.question: When driving to a school bus stop, the driver should:
questions.explanation: Always approach bus stops slowly and with caution.

questions.question: When checking tire condition, ensure that:

options.text: The insides are more worn than the outsides.
The outsides are more worn than the insides.
The middles are more worn than the outsides.

questions.explanation: Check that tire treads are worn evenly across the whole tire.

questions.question: For a conventional parallel parking maneuver, you should:

options.text: Pass the space while backing, then pull forward into it.
Pull forward past the space, then back into it.
Pull straight into the space without passing it first.
Back into the space without passing it first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull forward past the space, then back into it.
questions.explanation: Drive past the space, then back into it. Get the rear of your vehicle as close to the rear of the space as possible. Your vehicle must fit completely within the space.

questions.question: During a vehicle inspection, the landing gear should be:

options.text: More worn on the passenger's side than on the driver's side.

questions.explanation: When inspecting a trailer, make sure the landing gear is fully raised with no missing parts. The crank handle should be secure and the support frame should not be damaged.

questions.question: A school bus stop:

options.text: Can be added by the driver if there is a need.
Should be voted on by the students.
May change, depending on weather conditions.
Should be established by the proper school district authorities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be established by the proper school district authorities.
questions.explanation: A school bus driver cannot change a bus stop location without written permission from the school district.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you will be required to do all of the following, except:

options.text: Point to or touch each item.
Explain what you are checking and why.

questions.explanation: To pass the vehicle inspection test for your CDL, you must walk around the vehicle, point to or touch each item, and explain what you are checking and why. You will not crawl under the vehicle or hood.

questions.question: School bus stops may be changed by:
questions.explanation: Only the school district can change a bus stop location. The driver must have written approval from school district officials.

questions.question: ABS helps you:

options.text: Keep your wheels from locking up.
Count the number of students boarding the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your wheels from locking up.
questions.explanation: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) prevents your wheels from locking up when you brake hard on a slippery surface.

questions.question: When loading or unloading passengers, a school bus should be placed in ____ if there is no park shift point available.
questions.explanation: When loading or unloading students, place the bus in park if possible. If park is not available, place the bus in neutral and set the parking brake.

questions.question: The overhead inside rearview mirror:

options.text: Allows the driver to see what is happening inside of the bus.
Allows the driver to see what is happening outside of the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allows the driver to see what is happening inside of the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead inside rearview mirror in a school bus lets the driver watch what passengers are doing inside the bus.

questions.question: When completing an offset back/left parking maneuver, a driver should:

options.text: Pull straight forward, then back to the left.
Drive straight back, then pull forward to the left.
Pull straight forward, then drive straight back.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull straight forward, then back to the left.
questions.explanation: For an offset back/left parking maneuver, first pull straight forward, then back up to the left. The vehicle must be completely within the parking space boundaries.

questions.question: If a driver needs to exit a school bus to check for waiting students, the driver should:

options.text: Turn the bus off and take the key.
Ask a student to keep an eye on the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the bus off and take the key.
questions.explanation: If a student is missing during boarding, turn off the bus and take the key with you. Check around and underneath the bus for the missing student.

questions.question: When exiting a vehicle, it is important to maintain ____ with your vehicle at all times.
questions.explanation: When exiting a vehicle, face the vehicle and maintain three points of contact at all times. For a bus, keep contact with the handrail. Exiting incorrectly may result in automatic failure of the basic control skills test.
